record.bible_text: Then Samuel<WH08050> took<WH03947><WTH8799> a vial<WH06378> of oil<WH08081>, and poured<WH03332><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> upon his head<WH07218>, and kissed<WH05401><WTH8799> him, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>Is it<Fi> not because the LORD<WH03068> hath anointed<WH04886><WTH8804> thee <FI>to be<Fi> captain<WH05057> over his inheritance<WH05159>?
